runtimeEvidence: Fresh SQL Server 2025 isolated database: 32 migrations, 8 synthetic accounts; 30 desktop workflows passed, 15 SQL integration and 12 .NET unit tests passed. Final 160 executions running; do not infer full action completion.

tests.title: Documents: create/body version, publish, archive/unarchive, table/grid and reload
Snippets: literal content, edit/version, archive/unarchive and SQL reload
Read Later: add source, invalid/valid position, read/unread and remove preserves source
Favorites: typed reference, rank popup, server route navigation/reload and delete preserves source
Projects/Tasks: UI creation/edit, terminal cohort trash, restore and purge
Calendar: timed/all-day UI create/edit, views, complete/cancel and SQL state
Bookmark: validation, dirty discard, create/edit/archive/unarchive and SQL persistence
Tag: create, rename, cancel delete, delete and owner SQL
Finance: category, exact decimal record, edit, usage guard and unused delete
Bookmark: real two-tab conflict preserves draft and explicit revision recovery
Bookmark: offline failure retains draft, real retry commits one row
Owner isolation: real User B login cannot read User A bookmark in API or UI
Goal: title-only creation does not require optional numeric target
Goal: numeric progress and explicit completed/reopen/abandoned lifecycle
Planner: pin, move day, unpin preserves source Task
Habit: real check-in correction, future schedule and pause/archive lifecycle
Reminder: preset, None, Exact and remove retains None intent
Files: baseline availability gate is enforced in UI and direct API
Toolbox Base64: Unicode round-trip, invalid decode recovery and confirmed clear
Toolbox URL: exact codec output never navigates or fetches pasted URL
Toolbox HTML: decoded hostile content remains literal text
Toolbox Hash: all five algorithms match independent oracle and legacy warning
Toolbox UUID: count boundaries, version, uniqueness and failed run clears old success
Toolbox Password: bounds and memory-only reset without exposing generated values
Toolbox JSON: semantic format/compact, parser error, retained input and recovery
Toolbox Regex: matching, ignore-case, truncation, invalid pattern and bounded timeout
Toolbox catalog: supported IDs, no persistent canary and unsupported network gate
Settings theme: explicit save, SQL owner/value, reload and unchanged module grants
Profile: invalid timezone preserves draft, vi/en persistence and Task instant unchanged
Profile: real two-tab conflict, explicit comparison retains draft, server version recovery
Search: body-only authorized match, safe source navigation and archive filter
Dashboard: real recent document projection excludes body and archived source
